# Chronograph GP

Skills and agents that teach agents to work with Chronograph GP. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [chronograph-pe/chronograph-gp-claude-plugin](https://github.com/chronograph-pe/chronograph-gp-claude-plugin), at commit `35cb3d1`.

Portfolio monitoring, valuations, and analytics for private capital GP teams.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Chronograph GP**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Chronograph GP**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install chronograph-gp@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

5 skills: `chronograph-budget-vs-actuals-variance`, `chronograph-fund-quarterly-review-pack`, `chronograph-markup-markdown-brief`, `chronograph-portfolio-company-one-pager`, `chronograph-tvpi-attribution-by-company`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
